## berth mount add

mount a socket of berth's user at target, under /run/berth-mounts/, from the org's next start

### Synopsis

mount a socket of berth's user at target, under /run/berth-mounts/, from the org's next start

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_mount_add/

```
berth mount add <org> <name> <socket> <target> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth mount add acme agent /run/agent/agent.sock /run/berth-mounts/agent/agent.sock
  berth restart acme   # to apply it
```
